entries.en: Been a while since I've seen you. What brings you back?
Hey, so, what happened up there?
Ain't they all, ain't they all.
No worries. I'm sworn to secrecy for a few of the things I did. Important thing is that you got your people out, right?
Long-lived, those asari. Seen it all and done it twice. She must be a good thousand years old.
She was. But her life ended on the Peak.
She was born when your race was riding around on livestock, waving big knives and dying of sniffles. Living history, there.
Trying to put one over on the old campaigner, eh? It's been an asari's age since there were any rachni.
If you can't say anything, no big deal. Points for imagination though, eh?
I heard the administrator's been arrested. Any chance you had something to do with that?
Spectre, right?
You're the Spectre that just got here, right? You stand out. Probably the guns.
I used to be a military tech. Except for Maeko's people, everyone's too corporate here. They just sit around sipping expensive water.
So what can I do for you today?
I'm the chief mechanic for Hanshan. Just call me Li. Humans have a problem saying my full name.
Got a team of twelve under me, keeping the shuttles coming and going.
You need a pass. You can get one from Anoleis or the managers. If you can polish enough gizzard.
There's the problems up on Peak 15. Synthetic Insights was shut down by Anoleis. And a Matriarch came through.
You looking for her? She took a shuttle to Peak 15 before we lost contact.
Fifteen's always had a lousy reputation. Nobody talks about what they do there. And everyone sent up comes back a little quieter.
Don't know. There's a blizzard up there, but we've had those before. Never cut the satellite uplinks before.
Scuttlebutt says Lorik Qui'in was on the take. So Anoleis shut down SI's offices. Quiet-like, so no offworld lawyers come in on it.
You need anything, I'll be here.
Don't worry. I'm not out to put a slug in your head.
It's a long story. Just thinking about it makes me tired all over.
Sorry, I really can't talk about it.
We managed to catch up with that asari Matriarch.
Would you believe... rachni?
Uh, what?
Yeah, that's me.
What do you do here?
I have to go.
How can I get into the garage?
You seem like you have an ear to the ground. What's happening around here?
Do you know where that Matriarch is now?
What sort of problems are there at Peak 15?
What was that about Synthetic Insights?
Who's asking?
That's what I like to hear! Let's see what you need.
Fair enough. Let me know if you need anything.
Most people here are. I wish you could take them all down.
So what can I do for you today?
Credit where it's due. There's a lot of corruption here. Maybe this will rein it in a bit.
Internal Affairs and Spectres all at once, eh? Anoleis is having a bad week.
Sure. If I wanted to lose my job and get sued into the next spiral arm. Security tracks card use.
Vehicle repairs, of course.
Just passing through.
He was corrupt.
Why do you ask?
That was an Internal Affairs investigator working for the Executive Board.
Maybe you could let me borrow yours?
Anoleis had shut down SI. Looks like he was trying to blackmail them. It happens often enough.
He got caught this time, though. Looks like the Executive Board is going to feed him to the nathak.
He dropped out in the middle of the investigation. Don't know what happened, but word is he's trying to hire bodyguards.
I guess he went too far this time. SI is open again, and Lorik Qui'in is strutting around looking all smug.
I guess he got whatever it was he wanted, because Lorik Qui'in's drinking up the hotel bar now.
I don't want to talk about it.
I can't tell you.
Yes.
Huh?
Why?
Personal questions
I need to leave this station.
Local news
Goodbye.
You have one, right?
Benezia
Peak 15
Synthetic Insights
Repairs.
Goodbye.
We found Benezia.
Rachni.
Yes.
Why?
Not me.
What can I do for you?
I'm sorry to hear that, miss. Your kind live so long, I kind of forget you can die at all.
Commander. There've been reports of noise from the Synthetic Insights office. Would you know anything about it?
Don't play me, Shepard.
Meet me at the hotel for a drink, before you talk to Qui'in. I'll be waiting.
Smartass, hm? That's fine. I can work with that.
Not here, Spectre.
Of course not. Why would I?
It's probably Anoleis' thugs ripping the place apart.
Speak plain. What's your interest?
I'm entirely innocent.
Must be Anoleis' thugs.
Don't be coy.
